name: Just Between Us - Couples Chat
description:
Just Between Us is a fun & flirty chat app for couples that want to keep the spark alive and ensure their messages (and photos) STAY PRIVATE.

We've all been there before: thinking that we were sending our spouse a sexy text only to have our 9 year old reply! Or even worse, sending a flirty personal text to the WRONG person!

Just Between Us lets you send Intimate Photos, Flirty Texts, Romantic Invites, Conversation Starters and even Thumb Kisses to your partner without the fear of your kids accidentally finding them first. 

The app is password protected so you can feel confident knowing that no one else will accidentally stumble across your personal conversations or photos. 

Communicating with your lover with Just Between Us is double encrypted so that no one else (not even the app programmers) can see or read your messages! It ONLY works with the one person that you're synced with, and you can rest assured that your messages are truly secure. Just Between Us voluntarily had their code audited by a 3rd security company to triple check that it couldn't be hacked. It truly is a safe and secure way to connect remotely with your lover! 

How It Works:

1. Download the app and set up your free account. 
2. Invite your sweetheart to do the same. 
3. Share your unique sync code with him or her.
4. Instantly send messages and photos to each other that no one else will see.

With Just Between Us, you’ll enjoy more flirting, more fun, and a deeper intimate connection with your sweetheart, and you’ll have peace of mind knowing that your messages will only be seen by one person... your partner! You’ll avoid the embarrassment of accidentally sending an intimate message to the wrong person, or wondering if someone else is also enjoying your sexy texts. 

So send that tantalizing text and share that flashy photo ;-) Just Between Us has got you covered! 

About In-app Purchases

This app is free to download and use right away. If you’d like to remove (tasteful, curated) ads, keep the chat history for more than 30 days, and include more fun & flirty graphics into your chat, please consider upgrading to the full version -- it’s reasonably priced and totally worth it! Besides, your purchase helps support & strengthen marriages & relationships everywhere. 

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. 

Visit https://getyourmarriageon.com/terms-of-use/ to read our full Terms Of Service and https://getyourmarriageon.com/privacy-policy/ to learn about our Privacy Policy.  

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q. Who is this app for?
A. it's designed for couples - adults in committed relationships (e.g. married couples).

Q. What do people use this app for?
A. Sending private, intimate messages - including photos and videos - that are to be ONLY SEEN by the one person you're synced with

Q. Can I chat with multiple people or groups with this messaging app?
A. No. You can message only the one person you're synced with.

Q. Are our messages truly private and encrypted?
A. Yes. This app uses a combination of RSA and AES encryption to guarantee private communication.

Q. Besides sending messages and photos, what else makes this app unique?
A. You can send each other "thumb kisses", create photo galleries of your favorite photos, stage photos and videos to send for later, create disappearing images, answer flirty questions to spark conversation, and send sexy invites to each other.
